proof_body:
by
  intro V _ _ a b hb
  have hb2 : 0 < ‖b‖ ^ 2 := by positivity
  have horth : inner ℝ (a + (-(inner ℝ a b) / ‖b‖ ^ 2) • b) b = 0 := by
    rw [inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    field_simp
    ring
  refine ⟨horth, fun t => ?_⟩
  set t₀ : ℝ := -(inner ℝ a b) / ‖b‖ ^ 2 with ht₀
  have e : a + t • b = (a + t₀ • b) + (t - t₀) • b := by module
  have hsq : ‖a + t • b‖ ^ 2 = ‖a + t₀ • b‖ ^ 2 + (t - t₀) ^ 2 * ‖b‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [e, norm_add_sq_real, real_inner_smul_right, horth, norm_smul, mul_pow, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
    ring
  have hle : ‖a + t₀ • b‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖a + t • b‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [hsq]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (t - t₀)) hb2.le]
  exact (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp hle
target_source: ∀ (V : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (a b : V), b ≠ 0 → inner ℝ (a + (-(inner ℝ a b) / ‖b‖ ^ 2) • b) b = 0 ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, ‖a + (-(inner ℝ a b) / ‖b‖ ^ 2) • b‖ ≤ ‖a + t • b‖
